newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hypobank to buy majority stake in Brau and Brunnen.
newsitem.headline: Hypobank to buy majority stake in Brau and Brunnen.

text.p: Bavarian bank Bayerische Hypo-Bank said on Thursday that it plans to purchase 24.8 percent of the brewing and drinks group Brau und Brunnen from fund managers Porta Vermoegensverwaltung GmbH.
The purchase of the stake will increase Hypo-Bank's share in Brau und Brunnen from a current level of 33.6 percent to a controlling stake in the company.
The sale is planned to take place this year and is subject to approval by the German cartel office, Hypo Bank said in a statement.
